create_food_101_dataset: create a FOOD-101 classification dataset from raw images into VISSL-compatible folder structure
download_food101_dataset: download and extract the FOOD-101 dataset archive from ETH Zurich into a specified root directory
create_food_101_disk_folder: create train and test disk folders with class subdirectories for the FOOD-101 dataset
cleanup_food101_files: cleanup unused food-101 archive and extracted folders from the output directory
run_food101_script: run the FOOD-101 data preparation script with input and output paths via argparse CLI
